description: How suitable the weather in one city or town is for travelling and sleeping in a campervan, as a 0-100 score for today and for the coming 7 days, with the city's place among the cities of its country this week, comfortable days, the best stretch and the worst day, a 7-day forecast with day and night temperature and rain, today's score breakdown (thermal, sunshine, precipitation, wind), sleep, driving and solar scores and ready-made advice. Use this, not get_country_travel_weather, when the user names a place (Barcelona, Málaga, Alicante). Use it for the weather in one named city, town or place today, tomorrow or this week.

city.description: City or town name in any language, e.g. Barcelona, Málaga, Alicante.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to disambiguate (Barcelona ES vs Barcelona VE).

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

name: get_city_travel_weather
title: Travel Weather In A City
